baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Kobalt 12.5-amp heat gun, model 5208257. It features two fan speeds and a variable temperature control dial and is rated at 1500 watts. The main components are a plastic molded housing that encompasses a heating element, motor-fan assembly, power switch and power cord. It delivers hot air for heat shrinking, stripping paint, bending plastic, drying and thawing. The Kobalt 12.5-amp heat gun, model 5208257 is assembled in Thailand using components sourced from Thailand and China.

The main housing, front cover and heating element are produced in Thailand. The electric motor, fan, motor support, printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), switch, power cord, wiring, knob, back cover and support ring, heat insulator and fasteners are sourced from China. 

Final assembly in Thailand: press fit the fan to the motor spindle and attach the fan cover; crimp plugs to the heating element wires, add heat shrink tubing, solder wires to the switch and plug the heating element into the switch and PCBA; fasten the PCBA to the main housing, assemble the temperature knob, connect the PCBA to the motor, add the back cover and motor support; secure the power cord, add the switch slider, close the housing with screws, test, label and pack.

key_factors: Heating element and housing manufactured in Thailand combined with final assembly
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing the heating element and housing, and performing final assembly in Thailand
prediction.reasoning: A heat gun's primary function is generating and directing intense heat. The heating element, which imparts the essential heating function, along with the main housing and front cover, are manufactured in Thailand. Combined with the electromechanical assembly in Thailand (soldering, crimping, integrating the Chinese motor, fan, and PCBA with the Thai heating element and housing), the Chinese components undergo a substantial transformation in Thailand into a new and different article of commerce.

plans.description: Make Motor-fan assembly and PCBA (SMT) in Thailand
plans.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Kobalt 12.5-amp heat gun, model 5208257. It features two fan speeds and a variable temperature control dial and is rated at 1500 watts. The main components are a plastic molded housing that encompasses a heating element, motor-fan assembly, power switch and power cord. It delivers hot air for heat shrinking, stripping paint, bending plastic, drying and thawing. The Kobalt 12.5-amp heat gun, model 5208257 is assembled in Thailand using components sourced from Thailand and China.

The main housing, front cover, heating element, electric motor, fan, motor support and printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) are produced in Thailand. The switch, power cord, wiring, knob, back cover and support ring, heat insulator and fasteners are sourced from China. 

In Thailand, the electric motor, fan and motor support will be produced in-house: stamp rotor laminations from silicon steel; stack laminations and wind the rotor; build the stator; assemble the motor; press-fit the fan to the motor spindle.

In Thailand, the printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) will be produced in-house: SMT placement and reflow of the printed circuit board assembly; test the PCBA.

Final assembly in Thailand: press fit the fan to the motor spindle and attach the fan cover; crimp plugs to the heating element wires, add heat shrink tubing, solder wires to the switch and plug the heating element into the switch and PCBA; fasten the PCBA to the main housing, assemble the temperature knob, connect the PCBA to the motor, add the back cover and motor support; secure the power cord, add the switch slider, close the housing with screws, test, label and pack.

key_factors: Heating element, electric motor-fan assembly, and PCBA
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing the motor, heating element, and PCBA via SMT, followed by final assembly in Thailand
prediction.reasoning: The components that impart the essential character of the heat gun—the heating element, electric motor, fan, and PCBA—as well as the main housing, are all manufactured in Thailand (including complex processes like rotor stamping/winding and SMT placement, similar to N345938 and N342124). The Chinese components (cord, switch, knob, fasteners) are secondary. Combining the Thai-made core functional subassemblies with minor Chinese parts in Thailand substantially transforms the components into a new article of commerce of Thai origin.

verdict.reasoning: In N347421 and N345859, CBP held that the heating element, electric motor, fan, and temperature controls/PCBA impart the essential identity and functionality to fan-forced heating appliances. In Variant A, although the housing and heating element are made in Thailand, the motor, fan, and PCBA are sourced from China, making China the country of origin. In Variant B, the manufacturing of the electric motor (stamping laminations, winding rotor, building stator), fan, motor support, and PCBA (via SMT placement and reflow) moves to Thailand. With all core functional components and final assembly in Thailand, origin shifts to Thailand.
